name: Caffeine
overview: Scripture acknowledges that God has provided all plants and foods for our sustenance, as seen in Genesis 1:29 and 9:3, affirming that every herb and living thing is given for our nourishment. While the Bible warns against the deceptive and harmful effects of substances like wine and strong drink (Proverbs 20:1), it also teaches that true defilement comes from within, not from what we consume externally (Mark 7:15). Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, honoring God in all things, including our dietary choices (Romans 12:1), remembering that the kingdom of God transcends mere food and drink and is characterized by righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit (Romans 14:17).
